column1: Animal migration, however it is defined, is far more than just the movement of animals.
column2: 无论怎样定义，动物迁徙都远不只是动物换个地方。
column4: however it is defined|无论怎样定义

column1: It can loosely be described as travel that takes place at regular intervals — often in an annual cycle — that may involve many members of a species, and is rewarded only after a long journey.
column2: 笼统地说，迁徙是按一定间隔发生的旅行，往往以一年为一周期；同一物种可能有许多个体参与，只有经历漫长旅程后才能获得回报。
column6: members of a species|同一物种的个体

column1: It suggests inherited instinct.
column2: 迁徙让人想到一种与生俱来的本能。

column1: The biologist Hugh Dingle has identified five characteristics that apply, in varying degrees and combinations, to all migrations.
column2: 生物学家休·丁格尔归纳了五项特征：所有迁徙活动都具有这些特征，只是程度和组合方式有所不同。

column1: They are prolonged movements that carry animals outside familiar habitats; they tend to be linear, not zigzaggy; they involve special behaviours concerning preparation (such as overfeeding) and arrival; they demand special allocations of energy.
column2: 迁徙是持续较久的移动，会让动物离开熟悉的栖息地；路线往往较为笔直，少有曲折。它涉及出发准备和抵达时的特殊行为，例如在出发前大量进食，还要求动物专门分配能量。

column1: And one more: migrating animals maintain an intense attentiveness to the greater mission, which keeps them undistracted by temptations and undeterred by challenges that would turn other animals aside.
column2: 还有一点：迁徙中的动物会全神贯注于一个更大的目标，因此不受诱惑分心，也不因那些会让其他动物半途转向的挑战而退缩。
column8: turn other animals aside|使其他动物半途转向

column1: An arctic tern, on its 20,000 km flight from the extreme south of South America to the Arctic circle, will take no notice of a nice smelly herring offered from a bird-watcher’s boat along the way.
column2: 北极燕鸥从南美洲最南端飞往北极圈，航程达两万公里。即使有观鸟人从沿途的船上递出一条气味诱人的鲱鱼，它也会视而不见。
column6: take no notice of|对……不予理会

column1: While local gulls will dive voraciously for such handouts, the tern flies on.
column2: 当地的海鸥会贪婪地俯冲下去抢这些投喂的食物，燕鸥却径直飞走。

column1: Why?
column2: 为什么呢？

column1: The arctic tern resists distraction because it is driven at that moment by an instinctive sense of something we humans find admirable: larger purpose.
column2: 北极燕鸥之所以抵得住干扰，是因为此时驱使它的是一种本能：追求一个更大的目标，而这正是我们人类所钦佩的。

column1: In other words, it is determined to reach its destination.
column2: 换句话说，它一心要到达目的地。

column1: The bird senses that it can eat, rest and mate later.
column2: 它凭本能知道，以后还有时间进食、休息、交配。

column1: Right now it is totally focused on the journey; its undivided intent is arrival.
column2: 眼下，它全神贯注于这趟旅程，唯一的目标就是抵达。

column1: Reaching some gravelly coastline in the Arctic, upon which other arctic terns have converged, will serve its larger purpose as shaped by evolution: finding a place, a time, and a set of circumstances in which it can successfully hatch and rear offspring.
column2: 飞到北极一处其他燕鸥已经聚集的砾石海岸，有助于实现进化赋予它的更大目标，就是找到一个合适的地点、时机和环境，使它得以顺利孵卵、育雏。
column6: shaped by evolution|由进化塑造的

column1: But migration is a complex issue, and biologists define it differently, depending in part on what sorts of animals they study.
column2: 但迁徙是复杂的现象。生物学家的定义并不一样，部分原因在于他们研究的动物种类不同。
column5: depending in part on|部分取决于

column1: Joel Berger, of the University of Montana, who works on the American pronghorn and other large terrestrial mammals, prefers what he calls a simple, practical definition suited to his beasts: ‘movements from a seasonal home area away to another home area and back again’.
column2: 蒙大拿大学的乔尔·伯杰研究美洲叉角羚等大型陆生哺乳动物，他更喜欢采用一个自认为简单实用、适用于这些动物的定义：“离开季节性栖居地移往另一处栖居地，然后再返回。”
column7: seasonal home area|季节性栖居地

column1: Generally the reason for such seasonal back-and-forth movement is to seek resources that aren’t available within a single area year-round.
column2: 这种季节性往返迁移，通常是为了寻找单一地区无法全年提供的资源。

column1: But daily vertical movements by zooplankton in the ocean — upward by night to seek food, downward by day to escape predators — can also be considered migration.
column2: 不过，海洋浮游动物日复一日的垂直移动——夜里上浮觅食，白天下沉躲避捕食者——也可以算迁徙。

column1: So can the movement of aphids when, having depleted the young leaves on one food plant, their offspring then fly onward to a different host plant, with no one aphid ever returning to where it started.
column2: 蚜虫的移动也可以算。它们吃光一株食用植物的嫩叶后，后代便接着飞往另一株寄主植物，没有哪一只蚜虫会返回自己的出发地。

column1: Dingle is an evolutionary biologist who studies insects.
column2: 丁格尔是研究昆虫的进化生物学家。

column1: His definition is more intricate than Berger’s, citing those five features that distinguish migration from other forms of movement.
column2: 他的定义比伯杰的更复杂，列举了把迁徙与其他移动形式区别开来的那五项特征。

column1: They allow for the fact that, for example, aphids will become sensitive to blue light (from the sky) when it’s time for takeoff on their big journey, and sensitive to yellow light (reflected from tender young leaves) when it’s appropriate to land.
column2: 这些特征能够涵盖这样的现象：比如，当蚜虫该起飞、踏上漫长旅程时，会对天空中的蓝光变得敏感；而到了适宜降落的时候，它们会对嫩叶反射的黄光变得敏感。

column1: Birds will fatten themselves with heavy feeding in advance of a long migrational flight.
column2: 鸟类会在长途迁飞之前大量进食，积累脂肪。

column1: The value of his definition, Dingle argues, is that it focuses attention on what the phenomenon of wildebeest migration shares with the phenomenon of the aphids, and therefore helps guide researchers towards understanding how evolution has produced them all.
column2: 丁格尔认为，他的定义之所以有价值，是因为它让人关注角马迁徙与蚜虫迁移这两种现象的共同之处，进而帮助研究者理解，进化如何塑造了这些形形色色的迁徙行为。

column1: Human behaviour, however, is having a detrimental impact on animal migration.
column2: 然而，人类行为正在给动物迁徙带来不利影响。

column1: The pronghorn, which resembles an antelope, though they are unrelated, is the fastest land mammal of the New World.
column2: 叉角羚长得像羚羊，但两者没有近亲关系。它是新大陆跑得最快的陆生哺乳动物。

column1: One population, which spends the summer in the mountainous Grand Teton National Park of the western USA, follows a narrow route from its summer range in the mountains, across a river, and down onto the plains.
column2: 有一群叉角羚在美国西部山地的大提顿国家公园度夏。它们从山中的夏季活动区出发，沿着一条狭窄的路线越过河流，向下走到平原。
column5: Grand Teton National Park|大提顿国家公园

column1: Here they wait out the frozen months, feeding mainly on sagebrush blown clear of snow.
column2: 它们在那里熬过冰冻的几个月，主要以风吹走积雪后露出来的山艾灌木为食。
column7: blown clear of snow|被风吹去了积雪的

column1: These pronghorn are notable for the invariance of their migration route and the severity of its constriction at three bottlenecks.
column2: 这些叉角羚引人注意的地方，在于迁徙路线始终不变，而且有三处瓶颈把通道挤得格外狭窄。

column1: If they can’t pass through each of the three during their spring migration, they can’t reach their bounty of summer grazing; if they can’t pass through again in autumn, escaping south onto those windblown plains, they are likely to die trying to overwinter in the deep snow.
column2: 如果春季迁徙时不能逐一通过这三处瓶颈，它们便到不了牧草丰美的夏季觅食地；如果秋季不能再次穿过这些地方，南下到那些多风的平原避寒，它们多半会在试图熬过深雪中的寒冬时死去。
column5: bounty of summer grazing|丰饶的夏季牧草

column1: Pronghorn, dependent on distance vision and speed to keep safe from predators, traverse high, open shoulders of land, where they can see and run.
column2: 叉角羚依靠远距离视力和速度避开捕食者，因而会走过地势较高、视野开阔的山肩；在那里，它们既能看得远，也能跑得开。
column7: shoulders of land|较开阔的高地肩部

column1: At one of the bottlenecks, forested hills rise to form a V, leaving a corridor of open ground only about 150 metres wide, filled with private homes.
column2: 在一处瓶颈，两侧林木茂密的山坡围成一个V形，其间留下仅约150米宽的开阔通道，而里面已布满私人住宅。

column1: Increasing development is leading toward a crisis for the pronghorn, threatening to choke off their passageway.
column2: 日益加剧的开发正把叉角羚推向危机，可能彻底堵住它们的迁徙通道。

column1: Conservation scientists, along with some biologists and land managers within the USA’s National Park Service and other agencies, are now working to preserve migrational behaviours, not just species and habitats.
column2: 自然保护科学家与美国国家公园管理局及其他机构的一些生物学家和土地管理人员携手合作，如今除了保护物种及栖息地，也在努力保护迁徙行为本身。
column5: National Park Service|国家公园管理局

column1: A National Forest has recognised the path of the pronghorn, much of which passes across its land, as a protected migration corridor.
column2: 一处国家森林已把叉角羚的这条路线认定为受保护的迁徙廊道，其中大部分路段经过该森林管理的土地。
column7: protected migration corridor|受保护的迁徙廊道

column1: But neither the Forest Service nor the Park Service can control what happens on private land at a bottleneck.
column2: 但不论森林管理局还是国家公园管理局，都管不了瓶颈处私人土地上发生的事。

column1: And with certain other migrating species, the challenge is complicated further — by vastly greater distances traversed, more jurisdictions, more borders, more dangers along the way.
column2: 对于另外一些迁徙物种，挑战还要复杂得多：迁徙距离长得多，要经过更多管辖区、跨过更多边界，一路上也有更多危险。

column1: We will require wisdom and resoluteness to ensure that migrating species can continue their journeying a while longer.
column2: 我们需要智慧和坚定的决心，才能让迁徙物种的旅程再延续下去。
column7: a while longer|再延续一段时间
